welcome: 👋 Hello, {0}! Welcome to the Professional PDF Converter Bot. Select an operation from the menu below: • 🖼 Images to PDF: Combine JPG, PNG, WEBP photos • 📝 Text to PDF: Multi-page Unicode (Uzbek Latin/Cyrillic, RU, EN) • 📄 Convert Document: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, RTF, CSV, HTML • 📚 Merge PDF Files: Combine PDFs & Office documents • 🛠 PDF Tools: Compress, Rotate, Split, Extract Pages/Images, Page Numbers • ⚙️ Settings: Configure default page size and orientation Use /cancel at any time to stop the current action. /language — Choose your language.
help: 📖 Bot User Guide 1. Images to PDF: Upload up to 50 images, then choose A4, A5, or Original layout. 2. Text to PDF: Send any text message (supports o‘, g‘, ў, қ, ғ, ҳ). Use # Heading for titles. 3. Convert Document to PDF: Upload DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT, PPTX, ODT, RTF, TXT, CSV, or HTML. 4. Merge PDF Files: Send multiple PDFs in order and tap 'Merge'. 5. PDF Tools: Upload a single PDF to compress, rotate, extract pages, split, or add page numbers. 🔒 Privacy & Security: All uploaded and converted files are automatically deleted immediately after processing. Use /rename to rename a file.
